content: Yesus no fai ete lepra taura bagu jigemu tuwai.
Yesus no muju awadu heigedu mini gainga, fai-aita bagu toomaro no oojo tudu minane.

Ono ganenga fai ete no lepra taura bagu waha no Yesus bagu maidu bona, afo tuburu kutudu benou letuwai, “Anyakaro, ne gau hinei mata wonga, ji yame lepra taura jigemu hayahenga, ji Itou ago langa eege heigoni.”
Ono wainga Yesus no fai waha la owo tafa bona letuwai, “Ji gau hina. Ne eege heigau.” Ono wainga fasayadu onou, nomo lepra taura usu wainga no eege heigai.

Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ure dewau. Ne fai ete dada ne langa heigaha waha adai letuwau. Ne goidu bonahe gete gala pris abitimu nigi bonahe, ne toota amina Moses no lewai onou onowau. Ono wahenga fai nere name taura usu hinaha waha edo isodbode.”
Yesus no oota fai nebere kepten nomo haruwe magana taura jigemu fuwai.
Yesus no Kaperneam matane huwanya goi gainga, Romha 100 oota fai nebere kepten ete maidu Yesus danga bagu benou isoki tuwai,
“Anyakaro, yame haruwe magana ete taura tuwaha mata langa inyina, no gogala oruwa dalege borowaha, gogala jimiri anyakaro tuna.”
Ono wainga Yesus letuwai, “Ji goidu figini tuwehenga hilou heigon bona.”
Onou wa kepten no gidu benou letuwai, “Anyakaro, ne yame mata langa mayei nomo ji fai hilou uwa. Ne ewe lewahenga, yame haruwe magana nomo taura jige tuwona.

Ji benou leni, wa taate boni, ji fere nere fai unyinege bagu waha nebere huuna langa yafa genenga nere ji oofa hihide. Ariya ji yage yame oota fai nere yame huuna langa yafade. Onou wa ji ete le tuwon boni, ‘Ne goyau,’ ono genenga no goi-goina. Ji ete letuwoni, ‘Ne mayau,’ ariya no maimaina. Saini ji yame haruwe magana letuwoni, ‘Ne haruwe beha tau,’ ono genenga no haruwe waha tetena.”

Yesus beele waha isidu bona horoto wai. Onodu nere fai oojo tuwane waha lenigai, “Ji ngalenga letigini, ji amina fai ete tere Israel gamanege langa fai beha nomo huwanya ngalengawou dorofe ete urei uwa.
“Ariya ji tere letigini, fai-aita bagu baingaro nebere kantri hoonga mayou la, hoonga minou la awadu mai Abraham wonga Isak wonga Jekop wonga ha laluwa nomo huuna la gaara da nyou la yafodbode.
Ariya nere fai-aita amina Itou no nomo huuna la yafei nomo hangada nigai wa, Itou no nere so nigonga ha agugula goyodbode. Haumu waha langa merou anyakaro bagu manege gidodo wodbode.”
Ariya Yesus no kepten waha benou letuwai, “Elebe ne goyau. Ne huwanyate ngalenga na onounga, dada edo ne la heigon bona.” Saini waha langa tigini, kepten nomo haruwe magana ege jigi tuwai.
Yesus no Pita nomo tangabumu aita nomo taura jigemu fuwai.
Ariya Yesus no Pita nomo mata huwanya langa goidu bona, Pita oya nomo anya no kabali langa inyi gainga urai, taate bona no taura tubona gogala ngasu wai.
Ono wainga Yesus no nomo owo yaasu fuwainga, taura usu tuwai. Ono wainga no jaidu bona Yesus nomo da haiya fuwai.
Yesus no nere fai-aita toomaro nebere taura jigemu nagai.

Ariya esuwa nere fai-aita toomaro, hauri inyaba nere la inyane waha, hanigedu Yesus bagu mayane. Ono wanenga Yesus no lewainga nere hauri inyaba waha fai-aita bagu awa nigidu bode heige hara wane. Onodu no fai-aita bagu oruwanga nebere taura jigemu nagai.
Onodu onowou waha langa, Itou no nomo beele Aisaia hurau langa heigemu wai waha edomu wai. No benou lewai, “No nogo we, ere ebere taura hogo fere-fere elegedu bona so nigainga hara wane.”
Yesus no oojo tuwei nomo fanyimu bona lena.
Yesus no fai-aita bagu toomaro kolili tudu oto ganenga nerigedu bona, nomo disaipel benou lenigai, “Ere yaage katiwou ulate langa goyoya.”
Ono wainga nuuni beele nomo isou fai ete maidu bona Yesus benou letuwai, “Isisiwou fai, matane oruwa la goyau wa, ji oojo hinidu goyon boni.”
Ono wainga Yesus no benou letuwai, “Gauna kui nere oula langa nebere u-u bagu, neei nere fere nebere toomu bagu. Ariya Fai Nomo Idau no agore inyei nomo haumu uwau.”
Onodu fai ete no Yesus nomo disaipel ete, no Yesus benou letuwai, “Fai Anyakaro, ne awa hiyahenga ji goidu yame jijei u-u kurudu.”
Ono wainga Yesus no benou letuwai, “Buyona. Nere fai umeru wane waha, nere edo nere nage u-u kuru guru wode. Ne maidu ji oojo hiyau.”
Yesus lewainga jagui anyakaro folowai.
Ariya Yesus no bot digainga, nomo disaipel oojo tuwane.
Nere yaage kati wou gama langa goi bode, Yesus no agore inyai. Ono gainga jagui danga bagu jaidu bona hiiri bot kutau wona onowai.
Ono gainga nomo disaipel goidu aimu tubode letuwane, “Anyakaro, hoyo higau. Ere amina yai woya onoya.”
Ono wanenga Yesus lenigai, “Tere taate boya umugeya? Tebere huwanyatege ngalengawou gai menakele mene.” Onodu bona, no jaidu jagui hiiri ngare honggoro nirainga wanga nini helewai.
Ono wainga nere ninanege baingaro isidu bode lewane, “Taate fai benou, jagui yaage ngare nomo beele isare?”
Yesus no hauri inyaba, fai nga langa inyai waha so narai.

Yesus no Galili yaage katiwou ulate langa goi heigai, Gadara nebere oula langa. Ono wainga, fai nga nononga hauri inyaba bagu maidu toroba tuware. Nere haumu matmat langa onou yafadu bodere mai heigare. Nere gai kui deware, onou waha bona, nere fai-aita bagu jala waha langa golowei nomo edo uwa.
Ariya, nere danga bagu benou yaurare, “Ne Itou nomo Idau, ne ere adadu ono higau ganga? Iinga saini wei uwa, ne ere inyabamu higau ganga belanga mainaha yo?”
Buuwa toomaro menanga baae langa da nyi bode oto waneha.
Ono ganenga hauri inyaba nere Yesus danga bagu benou yauredu letuwane. “Ne ere so higei mata bonahe wonga wa, ne ere awa higahenga, buuwa toomaro woha huwanyanege langa goyoya.”

Ono wanenga Yesus no lenigai, “Tere goyagu.” Ono wainga nere hauri inyaba, fai nga waha awa niridu bode, nere buuwa waha huwanyanege langa goyane. Ono wanenga buuwa waha oruwanga danga bagu gurarudu bode, ha inyaba ete langa minane. Onodu bode, nere yaage katiwou langa me taumerudu bode, yaage nyidu umeru waneha.

Nere buuwa oofa nigi gou fai waha uredu bode, nere heige hara wane. Nere goi taon langa heigedu bode, fai-aita bagu dada heigai waha lenigane. Onodu nere dada fai nga nononga hauri inyaba bagu langa heigai waha hai nagane.
Ono wanenga, nere taonha fai-aita bagu oruwanga Yesus bagu mayane. Onodu saini nere mai uredu bode, no nebere oula awadu ha fere langa goyei nomo bode beele danga bagu letuwane.
